title: Sweetwater Hospital Association Case Study
summary: See how Sweetwater Hospital improved revenue cycle results, cutting AR days by 14% and increasing cash flow $1M/month with TruBridge nTrust.
body_markdown:
**Snapshot: Long-term partnership results in a better business office**


TruBridge helped Sweetwater Hospital Association keep up with the complexities of today’s healthcare billing by ramping up its business office. TruBridge was able to introduce nTrust to fill a knowledge gap that existed with Sweetwater’s current business office team and increase cash flow, among other notable results.
